description: I am a Republican who holds traditional conservative values, as can be verified by examining my record of service, both on my hometown’s school board and in the Montana legislature. I have supported or had drafted—and passed into law—legislation that is focused on ensuring that government actions are necessary, limited, effective, and fiscally prudent.
